mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is always active when the rate is low, without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 550000 signal a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 550000.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 102) during economic expansion (GDPC1 growth > 1.0% annualized) signals robust supply conditions and strong corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO > 102 and GDPC1 growth (QoQ annualized) > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 142000) indicates strong labor market conditions, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when PAYEMS > 142000.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260) during late-cycle expansion signals potential central bank tightening and reduced corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260 and the economy is in late-cycle expansion (as defined by GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 5.0%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high industrial production (INDPRO > 102) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 18500) indicate robust economic activity across supply and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO > 102 and GDPC1 > 18500.
